37.description: This vector represents names, proper nouns, and specific character sequences across multiple languages including English, Thai, and others.

150.description: This feature vector represents common English and Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical subword tokens.

187.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the letters 'am' or their Thai script equivalents.

199.description: This feature activates on mixed-script subwords, non-English characters, and multilingual token fragments.

111.description: This vector is related to the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (sɔ̄ sɯ̌a) and its common syllabic combinations or contextual character fragments.

73.description: This feature vector represents common word endings and linguistic suffixes across multiple languages.

83.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to biochemical and molecular biology terminology, particularly chemical prefixes and scientific roots.

112.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the Thai consonant 'บ' (Bo Baimai) and the Latin letter 'B/b'.

121.description: This vector activates for common subwords and morphemes found across various non-English and multilingual scripts, particularly European and Southeast Asian languages.

117.description: This vector activates on Thai script characters, common Thai syllable components, and subword tokens frequently found in Thai text.
